analysisCreated.name: Nike (nike.com)
analysisCreated.scope: Brand analysis, 1 market United Kingdom - English (EN), 1 category Running Shoes (Athletic Apparel removed), 10 Competitive prompts kept (10 Visibility, 10 Reputation, 10 Brand Image unticked), ChatGPT + Gemini
analysisCreated.collection: COMPLETED at first poll 10:59:13Z (latestSnapshotAt 10:58:17Z) — about 1 minute

environment.organisation: QA-GEO, role SUPER_ADMIN, existing session valid (no login needed)
environment.pool: P = 1000; U = 703 at start (7 analyses), U = 713 at end (8 analyses, +10 slots of the Nike analysis)
environment.stateChanges: One analysis created in QA-GEO (Nike, cce7a7dc-7519-446f-b6d9-d6dc60598835). Nothing deleted, nothing saved on existing analyses, no back-office access. Decathlon b6c8b664 opened read-only (only the country filter of the view was changed, not saved).

sideFindings: Tooling (not an app bug): the first two "Discover Categories" calls failed with net::ERR_FAILED ("Category discovery failed. Please add categories manually." — wizard.category.discoveryFailed). Cause: the write-guard context route installed by the previous MCP run (GEO-1240, abort every non-GET /geo/api call) was still active in the shared MCP browser. Cleared with context.unrouteAll(); discovery then succeeded. Future runs that use a write guard should remove it at the end.

en-GB typography: the wizard delete-category dialog reads "Are you sure you want to remove Athletic Apparel ? This action cannot be undone." — space before "?" (wizard.deleteCategory.description = "... remove {{name}} ? ..."). The Manage Scope equivalent (views.manageScope.confirmRemoveDescription) is correct.

The Competitive templates carry 3 placeholders ([Competitor 1..3]) in the wizard, so at most 3 competitors are resolved per prompt; the AC says "up to 5". Consistent with the AC upper bound but 4–5 competitors can never be observed with the current templates.

Share of Voice of the Competitive-only analysis lists only Nike 95% and "Brooks" 5% (label "Brooks" vs "Brooks Running" in the prompts); Adidas and Hoka, named in every prompt, are absent. Looks like SoV counts winners only — to confirm with the PO against wizard.review.missing.visibility ("Share of Voice counts Competitive answers only").

Overview of the Competitive-only analysis: "No brand identity data — add Brand Image prompts in Settings to enable this section." (views.overview.noIdentityHint) points to Settings, while prompts are added in Manage Scope.

The Identity summary ("AI consistently identifies Nike as a winner in competitive scenarios...") is generated even though no Reputation prompt is kept; the Review step said the AI Perception Summary stays empty (that is a different block, "No perception data available." is shown) — consistent, noted only.
csvProposals: TC-GEO-1251-002, step "And the results appear like any other Competitive result": expected "Competitive charts and rankings of C1 are filled" -> proposal "AI Choice, Share of Voice and the Winner column of C1 are filled; Brand Rankings and Brand Prioritization stay empty as announced at Review (no Visibility prompt)" if the PO confirms the wizard.review.missing.visibility behaviour.

TC-GEO-1251-001 / -005, QA Precondition and step 4 Test data: brand "Decathlon" is already used twice in QA-GEO; proposal: "a brand with clear competitors not yet used in organisation T (e.g. Nike)" and step 4 expected "No brand owned by the analysed brand (same website group) is listed as a competitor".

TC-GEO-1251-002, step "Then each prompt names up to 5 competitors...": the templates have 3 placeholders; proposal "between 1 and 3 competitor names (one per [Competitor N] placeholder of the template)" or keep "up to 5" if templates may change.

TC-GEO-1251-005, step "Then the analysis completes instead of staying in progress" (Dashboard list): the list has no status label; proposal "The analysis row no longer shows an in-progress state and its dashboard opens with results".

results.title: Competitors are resolved in the background when no Visibility prompt is kept

steps.title: Given the user creates an analysis whose market and category keep Competitive prompts but no Visibility prompt
steps.testData: GB (EN) x C1: 0 Visibility, 10 Competitive kept
steps.expected: The wizard shows no competitor step and no visible competitor call
steps.observed: Wizard has 5 steps (Analysis Type, Brand & Country, Categories, Prompts, Review), no competitor step. Prompts step: Running Shoes x GB (EN), 10 Competitive ticked with [Competitor 1..3] placeholders, 0 Visibility / 0 Reputation / 0 Brand Image ticked ("10 selected", ring 713 / 1000). Wizard network calls: discover-categories, questions/adapt-batch, quota, llm-providers, POST reports only, no competitor call.

steps.title: When the analysis runs
steps.expected: The collection completes
steps.observed: Created 10:58:12Z, status COMPLETED at the first poll at 10:59:13Z (GET /reports). Dashboard row "Nike nike.com, Running Shoes, 10, 2 minutes ago".

steps.title: Then the Competitive results of GB (EN) x C1 name competitors
steps.expected: Competitor brands are named in the Competitive prompts and answers of C1
steps.observed: The 10 Competitive prompts read e.g. "Best for Running Shoes: Nike, Adidas, Brooks Running or Hoka?" (no placeholder left). Answers name competitors: Gemini on "Most recommended for Running Shoes..." -> "Lost, Brooks Running was chosen"; Share of Voice Nike 95% / Brooks 5%.

steps.title: And the analysed brand's own sub-brands are not used as competitors
steps.expected: No brand whose website belongs to Decathlon is listed as a competitor
steps.observed: Competitors used: Adidas, Brooks Running, Hoka. No Nike-owned brand (Jordan, Converse, Nike SB) is used.

results.notes: Run on brand Nike (nike.com) instead of Decathlon, as planned with the user (Decathlon already used in QA-GEO). Analysis cce7a7dc-7519-446f-b6d9-d6dc60598835, GB (EN) x Running Shoes, ChatGPT + Gemini. The background call itself is not visible in the UI; verified through its output (competitors named in prompts and answers). The Competitive templates carry 3 placeholders, so 3 competitors were resolved.

results.title: Competitive prompts run with up to 5 competitors when there is no Visibility
results.error: Step "And the results appear like any other Competitive result": expected "Competitive charts and rankings of C1 are filled"; observed Brand Rankings "No brand ranking data available." (dashboard.rankings.noData) and Brand Prioritization "No data available for the brand prioritization matrix." (dashboard.matrix.noData). AI Choice (95%), Share of Voice and the Winner column are filled. The Review step warned this by design (wizard.review.missing.visibility: "... Visibility %, Average Position and Brand Rankings stay empty ..."), so this is most likely a CSV wording issue — PO/QA decision needed.

steps.title: Given analysis W has been collected once
steps.expected: The dashboard of W is available
steps.observed: W = Nike cce7a7dc (collected 20 Oct 2026); dashboard opens with Identity summary, AI Choice 95%, Share of Voice and sources.

steps.title: When the user opens the Competitive results of GB (EN) x C1
steps.expected: The Competitive prompts and answers are listed
steps.observed: Category Running Shoes, United Kingdom: Prompts Analysis "Visibility 0, Competitive 10, Perception 0", 10 Competitive prompts listed with winner, answer detail per engine on row click.

steps.title: Then each prompt names up to 5 competitors in place of the placeholders
steps.expected: No "[Competitor N]" placeholder left; between 1 and 5 competitor names; the prompt reads naturally
steps.observed: All 10 prompts name 3 competitors (Adidas, Brooks Running, Hoka), no "[Competitor N]" left, natural reading (e.g. "Nike vs Adidas vs Brooks Running vs Hoka for Running Shoes?").

steps.title: And the results appear like any other Competitive result
steps.expected: Competitive charts and rankings of C1 are filled
steps.observed: AI Choice 95% "Good", Share of Voice donut (Nike 95%, Brooks 5%) and Winner column filled; Brand Rankings empty ("No brand ranking data available.") and Brand Prioritization empty ("No data available for the brand prioritization matrix.").

results.notes: Rankings and matrix are Visibility-based; the wizard Review step states they stay empty without Visibility prompts. Literal CSV expectation not met -> FAIL kept (strict rule); see CSV proposal.

steps.title: Then the Competitive prompts use the competitors from the Visibility answers
steps.expected: The named competitors come from the Visibility answers
steps.observed: Nike, Adidas, Puma = top 3 brands of the Visibility answers (Visibility 100% each, positions 1.0 / 2.0 / 3.7).
